clips.hook: He asked for a push. Bad idea.
clips.title: Dom stopped to help a stranded van in GTA 6… big mistake
clips.caption: Never push a stranger's van in GTA 6 🐯
clips.voice_intro: Some strangers wave Dom down for a quick push. Their van has a passenger.
clips.voice_outro: Lesson learned: in GTA 6, check what's breathing in the back before you help anyone. Being a good Samaritan got him mauled.
